svg.title: Agentrix WebAgent Platform data architecture
svg.desc: Where each class of data lives in both profiles, what may cross the content-free boundary, the outbox to Kafka to lakehouse path, the observability pipeline, the visualisation surfaces, and the lifecycle controls (erasure, retention, backup, residency) that reach every store.

g.font-family: Inter, 'DM Sans', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif
g.text: Personal data stays inside its site's stores; only content-free rows cross the boundary. Blue = Vultr product · coral = holds keys · amber dashed = sealed, untrusted work.
INSIDE THE SITE WALL · ONE SITE · C0–C3
the first release: Vultr vector store
a data key per site, wrapped
The owner reads all of it. The back office reads by partition.
Visitor memory: public desks only, with a consent receipt.
in key holders only; sign-in secrets sealed
CONTENT-FREE BOUNDARY · ONLY C0 AND C1 CROSS
more only if the owner grants
Erasure orchestrator: each store returns a receipt
PITR + nightly per-site export to the copy region
Residency: home cell; inference location disclosed
Single node: the same stores as files under data/sites/<site>/, WAL shipped to Object Storage. Fleet: Managed PostgreSQL + pgvector, Valkey, Kafka, Object Storage per cell.
